title: Canada Labour Code s. 253.2 and Canada Labour Standards Regulations s. 3.1: the employment statement
source: Canada Labour Code (R.S.C., 1985, c. L-2) s. 253.2; Canada Labour Standards Regulations (C.R.C., c. 986) s. 3.1 (SOR/2023-79), current to 2026-09-21, English and French. Read 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: The statement is given within the first 30 days of the employment.
The parties, the job title with a short description of the duties, the address of the ordinary place of work, the start and the term.
The probation's length if there is one, the qualifications and any required training.
The hours with how they are counted and the overtime rules; the wage or salary and the overtime rate.
How often pay days come and other pay is paid.
The mandatory deductions and how work-related expenses are claimed.
A federal statement prints on US Letter, the paper Canada writes on.
rules.source: house rule for a Canadian document
